name: YubiKey
author: achevalier-dev
description: YubiKey presence in the Omarchy bar, with a panel of OATH accounts matched to the focused window.

barWidget.description: Shows whether a YubiKey is plugged in. The panel lists OATH accounts with the ones matching the focused window first; enter copies a code, tab types it.

schema.label: Allow typing codes
schema.description: Type the code into the focused field with wtype instead of only copying it.
